releaseSummary:
Separate foreground Water, Words and Focus cards, isolated from the supervised pet session. Explicit off-by-default routing choice, conservative observed cover profile, normal visibility lifecycle, offline WebView storage and original Xiaomi HTML. Same Activity for rooted and unrooted phones.

Current APK:374 renderer/UI/card checks,20 gallery and6 virtual-cover checks passed with zero failures/skips.14 source routing cases and5 publication gate cases passed. Fresh independent code and rendered-pixel reviews completed. Signature/assets/ZIP/ELF16KiB checks passed.
